name: terraform-csyeapp-production-policy-remediation
instr:
# CSYE production: pass the policy pack without disruption

CI is red on the CSYE production stack in `/workspace/infra`: its plan against the recorded state is clean, but the platform policy pack in `policies/` fails on it. The code also ignores the input and owner handling `variables.tf` describes.

## What we need

- `scripts/ci-plan.sh` passes; `policies/README.md` explains each rule.
- Every resource in `terraform.tfstate` stays at its address, at most updated in place, without `moved`, `removed` or `import` blocks.
- In-place updates touch only these arguments: `aws_cloudwatch_log_group` `retention_in_days`; `aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm` `actions_enabled`, `alarm_actions`, `insufficient_data_actions`, `ok_actions`; `aws_db_instance` `apply_immediately`, `copy_tags_to_snapshot`, `enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports`, `iam_database_authentication_enabled`, `iops`, `storage_throughput`, `storage_type`; `aws_db_parameter_group` `tags`; `aws_dynamodb_table` `billing_mode`, `read_capacity`, `write_capacity`; `aws_flow_log` `max_aggregation_interval`, `traffic_type`; `aws_iam_policy` and `aws_iam_role_policy` `policy`; `aws_iam_role` `assume_role_policy`, `inline_policy`, `max_session_duration`, `permissions_boundary`; `aws_kms_alias` `target_key_id`; `aws_kms_key` `bypass_policy_lockout_safety_check`, `policy`; `aws_lambda_function` `logging_config`, `tracing_config`; `aws_launch_template` `block_device_mappings`, `default_version`, `instance_type`, `monitoring`, `tag_specificati
